'''Boom Boom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Constable/Legends|constable]] in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. As of [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], he was a [[Security Chief's Second]]s at [[Bartyn's Landing]], and one of the few Seconds in whom the [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]] [[Mix Liddell]] completely trusted. Liddell assigned Boom Boom and other Seconds to investigate a coastal area where [[Menahuun]] had been seen. The Seconds went there riding [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]]. They were attacked by laser-armed Menahuun scouts and, in the first seconds of the fight, Boom Boom was blasted from his seat.
